accepted_technical_findings: The representative captures are centered, unclipped and visible on black, with clean Scene, Prefab Stage, Console and RenderTexture release evidence.
The five roles are no longer one identical bean silhouette and the approved FBX plus protected asset snapshot remain unchanged.
These technical improvements are retained as evidence but do not establish visual approval.
visual_failures: The captured contact seam is a tiny generic beveled hexagonal lump and does not read as a compressed fluid seam, cleft or body-contact event.
The upper pressure jaw is a plain blunt wedge without a gripping notch, opposing surface, folded pressure layer or hydraulic mechanism cue.
The anchored contact plate is a single featureless pentagonal prism; no anchor, indentation, fracture, inset or load path is visible.
The overturn slab is a smooth low-poly oval pebble with one point, not a torn or folding pressure slab with readable thickness and direction.
The heavy debris proof is another small featureless pentagonal pebble, so it does not support a purposeful three-piece breaching event.
Although the silhouettes differ, all five still share the same primitive extruded blue-blob language and remain materially below the supplied school-example and commercial VFX floor.

binding_r4_visual_contract.simplicity: Keep the construction simple and clean, but every volume must have a role-specific silhouette, cross-section and internal value hierarchy. Do not add noisy fragments or surface clutter.
binding_r4_visual_contract.muzzle_seam: Shape one short folded or pinched contact volume with a clear central cleft and unequal lips, plus hot-inner and soft-outer material layers. It may not be a hex, pebble, oval or featureless prism.
binding_r4_visual_contract.muzzle_jaw: Shape one visibly open pressure jaw with a captured inner notch, thick root, tapered outer cheek and one-sided curl or fold. The black proof must read as a hydraulic clamp or release layer without relying on labels.
binding_r4_visual_contract.impact_plate: Create one shallow but substantial anchored plate with a stepped perimeter, off-center impact depression, at least two unequal anchor shoulders and one controlled split. Avoid a flat card and avoid a featureless polygon prism.
binding_r4_visual_contract.impact_slab: Create one thick asymmetric overturning sheet-volume with a curled or lifted leading edge, torn unequal side and compressed rear root. It must show real depth and a forward roll direction rather than an oval pebble.
binding_r4_visual_contract.debris: Use exactly three unequal closed debris chunks derived from the plate/slab edge language, each with distinct proportions and one purposeful torn or stepped face; no generic pentagons or equal stones.
binding_r4_visual_contract.materials: Use restrained cyan-blue emission over darker transparent or metallic depth layers so internal folds remain readable on black and neutral gray; bloom may not erase the custom silhouette.
binding_r4_visual_contract.proof_limit: Return corrected individual black and neutral-gray proofs for the same five representative roles only. Do not create composite frames, timing captures, final prefabs or 30-cycle evidence before a new Root decision.

immutability: The approved normalized FBX SHA-256 b8b9f4325be5c1f78469a09a5c3baa033647555f1786c05da76aad3561294848 remains frozen.
R1-R3 artifacts, original endpoints, vendor assets, source materials, GUIDs and all original weapon assets remain read-only.
R4 writes must remain in new item-local StrictCustomDerived R4 paths only; runtime, catalog, MFI, combat and shared generator integration remain forbidden.
